locations.title: Shoot T.E.D.D
locations.description:
After installing T.E.D.D's Head on Ol' Tessie, shoot T.E.D.D's Head on the car dashboard ~10 times.  

Each time you land a shot, T.E.D.D.'s eyes will glow red, and he'll speak a series of phrases.

Eventually he'll get annoyed and electrocute you!

locations.title: Necrofluid Gauntlet Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- On or after Round 8, kill [UBER Klaus](#loc=500708) and pick up the stabilizer chip
- Take the chip to the prison cell in the police station in Ashwood and insert the chip next to the cell door
- Quickly throw stun grenades at [Klaus](#loc=500706) until he wakes up
- Lead Klaus to the computer at the Zarya Cosmodrome next to the [Door Buy](#loc=497017)
- Interact with the computer and stand in the sensor until the glass door opens
- Pick up the barrel and head to Ashwood and place it inside the [Power Pump](#loc=497291)
- Once filled, quickly head to Blackwater Lake and place it in the [Power Pump](#loc=497269)
- Then, quickly head to Vandoran Farm and place it in the final [Power Pump](#loc=497299)
- Head into the [bunker](#loc=496977) at the farm and place the barrel next to the mysterious cube
- Use the [fast travel](#loc=496967) to find symbols on the roof of the barn buildings and head back to the cellar
- Interact with the sides of the cube until the symbols on the roofs appear on each side, then interact with the cube
- Once you acquire the gauntlet, shoot the green orbs around the room

locations.title: Abomination Beam Tessie Upgrade
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to Exit 115 and kill zombies in the area until one drops the [Freezer Key](#loc=498006)
- Head inside the diner and interact with the freezer to open it and acquire the [Abomination Carcass](#loc=500710)
- Bring the Abomination Carcass to the [vehicle upgrade station](#loc=497067) in Ashwood to add the Abomination Beam to Ol' Tessie

locations.title: Turned to Ashes Song Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map, there are three headphones that need to be interacted with:
   - [Headphones](#loc=500712) in Ashwood
   - [Headphones](#loc=500713) in Janus Towers Plaza
   - [Headphones](#loc=500714) in Exit 115

locations.title: Racing Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head just south of Blackwater Lake in a cabin and head to the second floor
- Interact with the [Briefcase](#loc=500716)
- Race the RC car to the finish line in time to win a trophy

locations.title: World Champion of Axe Throwing Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to Blackwater lake and interact with the [World Champion of Axe Throwing Trophy](#loc=500718) in the tool shed
- Pick up a tomahawk (there is one outside the tool shed impaled in a log) and head across the street to see a floating target
- Keep throwing the tomahawks at the targets

locations.title: Ghost Girls Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to Vandoran Farm and head into the [farm house](#loc=496975)
- Go upstairs and interact with the [Television](#loc=500719) until only one figure shows up on the screen
- Head into the [cellar](#loc=496977) and walk up the ghost down there
- Head back to the television and interact with it until there are no figures on the screen
- Head next to the barn corner outside near the [fast travel](#loc=496967) and approach the two ghosts

locations.title: Bear Fight Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Acquire the perk Death Perception
- Head between either Ashwood and Exit 115 or Ashwood and the Zarya Cosmodrome until you find bear prints on the ground
- Follow the bear prints until you trigger a cutscene
- Kill Maldruk the Bear in the arena

locations.title: Cocktail Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside Exit 115's diner, there is a cup and a soda machine. Collecting specific items and interacting with the cup will make a free perk
- The type of perk depends on the ingredients:
   - Jugger-Nog:
      - [Weed](#loc=500728) in Janus Towers Plaza
      - [Jar of Milk](#loc=500730) in Vandorn Farm
      - [Carton of Eggs](#loc=500734) in Exit 115
   - Speed Cola:
      - [Box of Tomatoes](#loc=500724) in Ashwood
      - [Blueberry Plant](#loc=500725) in Blackwater Lake
      - [Sugar Packets](#loc=500733) in Exit 115
   - Quick Revive:
      - [Fish](#loc=500726) in Blackwater Lake
      - [Toilet Cleaner](#loc=500727) in Janus Towers Plaza
      - [Prototype Syringe](#loc=500731) in Zarya Cosmodrome
   - Stamin-Up:
      - [Bag of Beans](#loc=500723) in Ashwood
      - [Box of Potatoes](#loc=500729) in Vandorn Farm
      - [Jerrycan](#loc=500732) in Exit 115

locations.title: Ashes of the Damned Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, two other easter eggs will need to be completed
   - [Necrofluid Gauntlet Easter Egg](#loc=500707)
   - [Abomination Beam Tessie Upgrade](#loc=500709)
- Head down to the Zarya Cosmodrome and grab the [Wisp Tea](#loc=497011) perk, then head back to Ashwood
- Inside [one of the eastern buildings](#loc=497280) in Ashwood is a [black mirror](#loc=500751). Kill zombies nearby to summon a wisp who will enter the mirror
- Shoot the mirror with the Necrofluid Gauntlet and pick up the Powder of the Forgotten
- Head back to the Zarya Cosmodrome and interact with the powder on the table of [Yuri's lab](#loc=497029)
- Three sets of symbols will appear on the chalkboard, each denoting a specific ingredient needed:
   - Human Bones: Obtained by throwing a tomahawk on the [hanging zombie](#loc=500744) in Vandoran Farm to drop its foot then burning it with a molotov
      - The first symbol for this ingredient looks like a Greater Than symbol
   - Hoard Husk Chunk: Obtained by destroying the [Overgrown Hoard Husks](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-ashes-of-the-damned?search=overgrown_hoard_husk%20%26%26%20category%3A28039) in the fog with the Abomination Beam
      - The first symbol for this ingredient looks like an L
   - Widow's Lantern: Obtained by picking up the [Jar of Spores](#loc=500745) in Blackwater Lake and bringing it to the Vandoran Farm, interacting with the [horse carcass](#loc=500746), then interacting with it again three rounds later
      - The first symbol for this ingredient looks like a C
   - Ravager Eyes: Obtained by using a saw trap to kill a ravager
      - The first symbol for this ingredient looks like a C with a dot in the middle
   - Mysterious Limb: Obtained by killing Zursa the bear with the Abomination Beam
      - The first symbol for this ingredient looks like a L with a dot in the middle
- Interact with the three ingredients in Yuri's Lab in order from top to bottom
- Interact with the beaker to add your own blood
- Survive the lockdown that is caused for one minute
- With the serum complete, the [DG-2 Turret Tessie Upgrade](#loc=500740) will need to be completed
- Head back to Ashwood and shoot the faces of the clocktower with the DG-2 Turret
- Then, shoot each face of the clock with the Necrofluid Gauntlet. Each face will give one special charge to the gauntlet. Each of these next steps will require special charges and can be done in any order
- Exit 115
   - Head to Exit 115 and shoot at the light poles with lightning sparks with the DG-2 Turret until colored lightning strikes
   - Head to the roof of the garage and shoot the clock with the gauntlet
   - Quickly, drive Tessie into the red shipping container across the street to awaken the red-glowing Trucker zombie
   - Then, melee the cash register inside of the diner to awaken the blue-glowing Cashier zombie
   - Finally, summon Klaus and send him into the garage to awaken the yellow-glowing Mechanic zombie
   - Lead each zombie underneath to their respective lightning bolt that matches their color
- Zarya Cosmodrome
   - Head to the Zarya Cosmodrome and shoot the two radar dishes with the special gauntlet
   - Head inside the control room to find symbols and numbers on the screens. The symbols relate to a word which will determine what the codes on the screen need to be set to
      - If the first symbol is a box, the word is engine: 4, 13, 6, 8, 13, 4
      - If the first symbol is an L with a dot, the word is launch: 11, 0, 20, 13, 2, 7
      - If the first symbol is an upside-down L with a dot, the word is rocket: 17, 14, 2, 10, 4, 19
      - If the first symbol is a V with a dot, the word is weapon: 22, 4, 0, 15, 14, 13
- Vandorn Farm
   - Head to Vandorn Farm and enter the farmhouse
   - Read the time on the clock near the table and stand on the roman numeral on the ground the corresponds to the clock's hour
   - Once the father turns his head to look at you, shoot him with the special gauntlet
   - Four items will scatter across the farm that will need to be picked up:
      - [Tasty-Face](#loc=501490)
      - [Junior's Fun-Face](#loc=501491)
      - [Ma's Chalice](#loc=501493)
      - [Pa's Pigsticker](#loc=501492)
   - Place the four items in the center of Vandorn farm on the red circles
   - Protect the items from zombies
- Finally, head to Blackwater lake
- Head down to the dock and interact with the wisp there
- Head into the house and shoot the projector on the first floor
- Four locations will be shown. Memorize those locations in order and find and shoot the film reels at each location. The order for these is random
   - [Second Floor Film Reel](#loc=501529)
   - [Tool Shed Film Reel](#loc=501519)
   - [Boat House Film Reel](#loc=501524)
   - [Patio Film Reel](#loc=501527)
- Interact with the wisp on the second floor of the house
- Purchase Klaus from the radio and head back upstairs
- Command Klaus to stand in front of box where the wisp was
- Interact with Klaus behind the cabin to initiate the first phase of the boss fight
- Next, you'll need to enter Tessie and collect three wisps that appear in four areas of fog
   - Between Janus Towers Plaza and Blackwater Lake
   - Between Janus Towers Plaza and Vandorn Farm
   - Between Ashwood and Blackwater Lake
   - Between Ashwood and Vandorn Farm
- After the last wisps are collected, everyone will be teleported to the boss arena for the final fight

locations.title: DG-2 Turret Tessie Upgrade
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, the serum will need to have been created from the [Ashes of the Damned Main Easter Egg](#loc=500739)
- In the fog across the map, there will be three keys that spawn randomly in set areas that will need to be shot down using the Necrofluid Gauntlet
   - Bruin Key: Between Ashwood and the Zarya Cosmodrome
      - Holding this key will force you to only use your knife
      - [Bruin Key Spawn](#loc=505036)
      - [Bruin Key Spawn](#loc=505037)
      - [Bruin Key Spawn](#loc=505038)
   - Nightbird Key: Between Ashwood and Exit 115
      - Holding this key will decrease your maximum health
      - [Nightbird Key Spawn](#loc=505033)
      - [Nightbird Key Spawn](#loc=505034)
      - [Nightbird Key Spawn](#loc=505035)
   - Terrapin Key: Between Vandoran Farm and Ashwood
      - Holding this key will decrease your speed
      - [Terrapin Key Spawn](#loc=505041)
      - [Terrapin Key Spawn](#loc=505040)
      - [Terrapin Key Spawn](#loc=505039)
- Bring each key one by one to the Seal of Sorrow in Ashwood

locations.title: Dempsey Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- As Dempsey, head to the area between Ashwood and Zarya Cosmodrome
- Next to the cliff in a concrete tube, interact with the [dog tags](#loc=500736) in the snow
- After the cutscene, follow the black orb and kill all the zombies

locations.title: Spores Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Pick up one of the [Spray Canisters](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-ashes-of-the-damned?search=spray_canister%20%26%26%20category%3A14167) around the map.
- Spray one of the [Spore Plants](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-ashes-of-the-damned?search=spore_plant%20%26%26%20category%3A27994), which will attract zombies to the plant.
- Kill the zombies and let the plant fully grow to receive loot.

locations.title: Jump Pad Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, take every jump pad throughout the map.
- After, head to Janus Towers Plaza and wait until the [Blinking Light](#loc=938874) starts blinking.
- Keep track of the order and how many times it blinks. Each number correlates to one of the 7 jump pads:
   - [1 - Janus Towers Plaza](#loc=496960)
   - [2 - Vandorn Farm](#loc=496967)
   - [3 - Judgement Square](#loc=497009)
   - [4 - Blackwater Lake](#loc=496999)
   - [5 - Exit 115](#loc=497042)
   - [6 - Zarya Cosmodrome](#loc=497013)
   - [7 - Rabbit Alley](#loc=497006)
- After jumping in the order from every jump pad, a portal will spawn in the path of one of the jump pads. Head through it to teleport to Ashwood and receive a series of rewards.

locations.title: Ashes of the Damned Super Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, find and approach the Twins around the map, which can spawn in one of four locations:
   - [The Twins](#loc=959169)
   - [The Twins](#loc=959161)
   - [The Twins](#loc=959154)
- After the Twins disappear, obtain the [Necrofluid Gauntlet](#loc=500735) from the [Necrofluid Gauntlet Easter Egg](#loc=500707).
- Head to Vandorn farm and look up at the windmill to see the [Toy Box](#loc=957175).
- Shoot the Toy Box with the Necrofluid Gauntlet and reload to pull it down.
- Use the Dark Flare Field Upgrade on the box to bring it to the ground.
- Grab a [Spray Canister](https://mapgenie.io/cod-black-ops-7/maps/zombies-ashes-of-the-damned?search=spray_canister%20%26%26%20category%3A14167) from around the map and head to the Monolith Forest.
- High up around the forest on the sides of the blue rocks are pink crystals. Shoot the crystals with the Necrofluid Gauntlet and reload to pull them down, then use the Spray Canister on them by interacting with them.
- Do this three times and a [Meteor](#loc=957176) should crash into the road at the Blackwater Lake.
- Interact with the Meteor then flip rounds.
- After flipping rounds, the Meteor should break. Interact with the Meteor to grab a crystal from inside.
- Head back to the Toy Box and interact with it to put it inside. A Tessie Toy should come out.
- Interact with the Tessie Toy to pick it up, then Exfil.
